name: After 3 AM
desc:
After the horrific event at your old job, you are now staying at a rental shack not too far away from town, however, there has recently been murders and attacks nearby. 

Your goal is simple. Evacuate the area and don't die.

This game is a direct sequel to Before 3 AM, which you play here: 
https://www.roblox.com/games/3543648904/Before-3-AM

Create a private server to allow for up to 10 players in a lobby!

Current Version: 1.4.1 [BETA]
The update log can be accessed in-game
